Opportunity matrix plot

Source: R/visualization.R
plot_opportunity_matrix.Rd

Creates the classic ODI opportunity matrix: importance on x-axis, satisfaction on y-axis, with high-opportunity objectives highlighted. Optionally shows diagonal zone lines dividing the plot into Under-Served, Appropriately-Served, Over-Served, and Table Stakes regions (from quantjtbd).

Usage

plot_opportunity_matrix(
  scores,
  title = "Opportunity Score Matrix",
  subtitle = NULL,
  highlight_threshold = 10,
  show_zones = FALSE
)

Arguments

scores

A data frame from get_jtbd_scores() with imp, sat, and opp columns

title

Plot title (default: "Opportunity Score Matrix")

subtitle

Plot subtitle (default: NULL)

highlight_threshold

Opportunity score threshold for highlighting (default: 10)

show_zones

Show diagonal reference lines and zone labels (default: FALSE)

Value

A ggplot object

See also

Other visualization: plot.job_step(), plot_cleveland(), plot_this.graph.abs_score(), plot_this.graph.rel.abs_score(), plot_this.graph.rel_score(), theme_jtbd()

Examples

data(jtbd_sample)
scores <- get_jtbd_scores(jtbd_sample)
# plot_opportunity_matrix(scores)
# plot_opportunity_matrix(scores, show_zones = TRUE)
